# Test plan (v{{VERSION}})

## How to use this template

*The test plan describes how every acceptance criterion will be verified. Coverage is derived status and is not kept here: `node tools/trace-check/trace-check.mjs --write` regenerates `docs/trace/coverage.md` from the `@spec` annotations. To defer a criterion, list its ID in `deferred:` in the front matter. Only P2 and P3 criteria may be deferred, and deferral needs the owner's approval.*
